# pve_ceph_health_mutes (Data Source)

All currently muted Ceph health checks.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_ceph_health_mutes" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier: .
- `mutes` (Attributes List) Returned by /cluster/ceph/health-mute. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mutes))

<a id="nestedatt--mutes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `mutes`

Read-Only:

- `code` (String) The muted health check.
- `sticky` (Boolean) Whether the mute survives the check getting worse.
- `summary` (String) What the check reports.
- `ttl` (String) When the mute expires. Absent if it does not.
